requirements.title: Media and personal-content vocabulary: media-v1.ttl

Add `mv:MediaWork` (⊑ `:CreativeWork`) with `mv:Film`, `mv:TelevisionSeries`, `mv:TelevisionSeason`, `mv:TelevisionEpisode`, `mv:MusicAlbum`, `mv:MusicTrack`, `mv:Audiobook`, `mv:PodcastShow`, `mv:PodcastEpisode`, `mv:Game` to media-v1.ttl
Add `mv:MediaLibrary`, `mv:LibraryItem` (links a work to a library, `mv:itemOf`, `mv:inLibrary`), `mv:MediaFile`, `mv:RomFile`, `mv:GamePlatform`, `mv:MusicArtist` (⊑ `:Organization`) to media-v1.ttl

Add `mv:PlaybackSession` (⊑ `:Session`) with `mv:playedBy`, `mv:lastPlayedAt`, `mv:playCount`, `mv:playbackPositionSeconds`, and `mv:BroadcastStream` (⊑ `:Event`) with `mv:ViewerSample`, `mv:viewerCount`, `mv:sampledAt`, `mv:lastConnectAt`

Add `mv:DownloadRequest` (states requested, wanted, grabbed, importing, imported, failed), `mv:DownloadTransfer`, `mv:GrabEvent`, `mv:MediaIndexer` and properties `mv:requestsWork`, `mv:transferOf`, `mv:grabbedFromIndexer`, `mv:transferState`, `mv:shareRatio`, `mv:lastActivityAt`, `mv:addedAt`
Add `mv:TranscriptSegment` (part of the existing `:Transcript` in personal-v1.ttl: reuse, do not redefine) with `mv:segmentStart`, `mv:segmentEnd`, `mv:noSpeechProb`, `mv:transcriptOf`

Resolve the two name collisions: connector packages declare `:Episode` (TV) and `:Author` in the shared `:` namespace, while core-foundation-v1.ttl already defines `:Episode` (interaction unit) and software-v1.ttl `:Author` (git author). media-v1.ttl uses `mv:TelevisionEpisode`; cross-repo rows EG-MEDIA-VOCAB-R032 and EG-MEDIA-VOCAB-R033 move the connectors onto it
Content-channel vocabulary: content-v1.ttl
Add `cv:Feed`, `cv:FeedSubscription`, `cv:Article` (⊑ `:Document`), `cv:ResearchPaper` (⊑ `:Document`, seeAlso `bibo:AcademicArticle`), `cv:SearchQuery`, `cv:SearchResult`, `cv:SearchEngine`

Add `cv:SocialPost`, `cv:PublishingChannel`, `cv:EngagementMetric`, `cv:EmailCampaign`, `cv:MailingList`, `cv:Subscriber` (opaque identity), with `cv:sentCount`, `cv:viewCount`, `cv:clickCount`, `cv:postState`, `cv:subscriptionStatus`
Add `cv:MessageChannel` and `cv:ChatMessage`; reuse existing `kg:Team` from core-foundation-v1.ttl without redeclaration, with `cv:memberCount`, `cv:lastPostAt`, `cv:postedAt`, `cv:postedBy`
Add content properties `cv:publishedAt`, `cv:isRead`, `cv:feedUrl`, `cv:resultUrl`, `cv:rank`, `cv:servedByEngine`, `cv:doi`, `cv:arxivId`, `cv:citationCount`
Cross-source identity keys

Declare the eight key properties as datatype correlation properties in media-v1.ttl and content-v1.ttl, without global inverse-functionality. Work identity keys include the class and provider namespace (Film and TelevisionSeries IDs cannot collide). Article identity uses its class-scoped normalized canonical URL. SearchResult uses source, query and native result key; SocialPost and EmailCampaign retain source-native IDs. Shared target URLs support joins without identifying the result, post, campaign and document as one entity. Repeated reads of the same source-native key upsert the same entity
Specify normalisation (infoHash lower-case hex; canonicalUrl via scheme/host lower-case, tracking parameters and fragment stripped) as an `rdfs:comment` and a fixture table
Add the keyed-hash identity rule for email-derived joins (`cv:subscriberKey`), never storing the raw address
SHACL shapes
Shape: `mv:Film`/`mv:TelevisionSeries` carry at least one of `mv:tmdbId`, `mv:tvdbId`, `mv:imdbId` when sourced from a connector
Shape: `mv:DownloadTransfer` has exactly one `mv:infoHash` matching `^[0-9a-f]{40}$` or `^[0-9a-f]{64}$`
Shape: `mv:DownloadRequest` `mv:downloadRequestState` in the closed set (requested, wanted, grabbed, importing, imported, failed)
Shape: `cv:Article`, `cv:SearchResult` carry exactly one normalised `cv:canonicalUrl`; shapes are aggregate-free per the virtual-graph shapes convention
